name: Wizard OS 0.3.62 — Latest continuity (0.3.60 unchanged)
about: Latest continuity only: exactly the 0.3.60 runtime pins, so Latest testers keep their bundle while Stable moves to 0.3.61 (latest may not trail stable). Does not carry the 0.3.61 three-step guide or the stuck-orb fix; those reach Latest once wizard-ux #569 lands on main. Previous 0.3.60 description (historical): Latest 0.3.58 plus the same multi-account Claude change as Stable 0.3.59, so Latest never trails Stable: Claude app claude-connection 0.2.5 (#2; engine wizard-claude 0.2.5), App Manager 44fded3 plus #249/#252 (cherry-picked as #251), and Wizard UX main a0399680 (#558, includes #537). The UX move from e0900880 to a0399680 also carries 16 other merged main PRs (18 first-parent merges incl. #537/#558): #539 instant app open, #541 shared attach chip, #542 team rules v4 (docs), #543 refresh shortcut, #514 chat-row swipe actions, #515 My skin orb contrast (docs), #538 Notes sigil, #546/#550 refactors, #551 components brief limit, #552 launcher freshness, #553 Profiles sigil, #554 app context draft, #555 refresh button (Miguel's skins), #556 snooze lowest priority, #557 edge-peek tweak. Feature-classified; every other pin is 0.3.58's.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

wizard-app-manager.note: Latest 0.3.58's App Manager 44fded3 plus exactly #249 and #252, merged as #251 on the Latest maintenance branch. All declared image inputs unchanged (attested 80c76cf image).

wizard-troubleshooter.note: Host tooling, no image: installed by `wam troubleshooter` as user systemd units (wizard-troubleshooter.service + wizard-guardian.timer, report-only) from exactly this commit; 4b1f0ef plus #10 (MIT license, no behavior change), #12 (one bounded owner-approved repair tool set shared by Claude, ChatGPT and Tinfoil; host-independent paths; no file/command grants without a per-box policy) and #13 (Claude falls back to the agent's second Claude sign-in when the Claude app login hits its usage limit).

wizard-agent-service.note: Official main through #151; preserves final #149 guards after #150 supersession.

wizard-ux.note: Official main through #558 (pool default for new chats) and #537 (Opus to the ready Claude pool). See about for the 16 other main PRs since 0.3.58's e0900880.

wizard-app-manager.note: Official multi-arch main image from 80c76cf, workflow run 40171067383. Attestation reverified; all declared image inputs and workflow are byte-identical through 44fded38. Python backup engine is host-installed WAM source, not an image input.

shell.note: Alongside installs use the immutable official image above; index drift is informational.

ai-connection.note: Host Hermes owns and renews its sign-in; the connection app reads sanitized usage through the wizard-os dashboard plugin. Claude is installed by default as its own `claude-subscription` row below.

claude-subscription.note: Any number of Claude subscriptions (claude-connection #2; engine ghcr.io/humanitylabs-org/wizard-claude:0.2.5@sha256:4a8f91cfa6abc829d17af533f18d23932a131ca48e2e821e870db0f474a2436f, amd64+arm64, built by wizard-app-store #31 at 801afc58, run 40319542857). The original Claude Code sign-in keeps its volume/bind and stays the first row (its page moves to /claude-code/); added subscriptions sign in inside the agent (stock `hermes auth add anthropic`) through the wizard-os plugin broker on the agent's dashboard, which the App Manager wires up on alongside boxes. Alongside with host Hermes on a claude-subscription provider: App Manager still binds the agent's own Claude Code login folder at the engine's /claude; tokens are never copied.

secrets.note: secret-drop #1: the engine image is pinned by its multi-arch digest (secret-drop:0.1.1@sha256:29ebc6a7…c03302), the same bytes as the 0.1.1 tag in 0.3.19.

hermes.test_record: none: carried over from 0.3.21, pinned before Wizard stable existed

notes: 0.3.54: exact 0.3.50 non-UX source/image/default-app pins and Hermes block retained; UX uses the first main merge containing the complete reviewed onboarding repair, not newer unneeded main changes. Official multi-arch image provenance verified. James chose Stable 0.3.53 now, then a new backup+onboarding release for latest and exact-release acceptance before promotion. Earlier 0.3.50 passes are not acceptance for this release. Backup scheduler, AI-login exclusive handover, Tailscale re-enrolment and external-grant limitations remain as documented above. No Stable promotion is included.
